brief: short horror scene in a school corridor at night
concept: An ordinary school corridor where one classroom light keeps switching on by itself.
plan_outline: 1. EWS · eye · static · long school corridor at night, one flickering tube light · a cleaner with a mop at the far end (6 s)
2. MS · eye · static · same corridor · behind him, a classroom light switches on; he doesn't notice (4 s)
3. CU · eye · static · same corridor · he stops mopping and listens (3 s)
4. MS · eye · push in · the lit classroom doorway · empty desks; one chair slowly turned to face the door (6 s)
5. CU · eye · static · the cleaner · he backs away, breath visible in the cold light (4 s)
6. WS · eye · static · corridor · every light goes out at once; black (3 s)
why: Horror in an ordinary place; the threat is never shown (models make monsters look fake).
Static wides let the eye search; the only move is a slow push into the doorway.
Cold sickly light from practical tubes only; darkness does the work.
